He holds a degree in Mechanical Engineering and studied for a master’s degree in Mathematical Engineering at the Technological University of Panama.</p><p class="profile-bio">During his master’s studies, he investigated patient adherence to clinical trials using sequence mining, identifying behavioral patterns associated with participants’ continuation and dropout.</p><p class="profile-bio">In Panama, he has collaborated on studies of chronic kidney disease prevalence and participates in research on polycystic kidney disease and breast cancer, analysing information from radiology reports.</p><p class="profile-bio">His doctoral research focuses on causal inference and conformal inference, with a particular interest in uncertainty quantification when using machine learning models or small samples. His project is supervised by <a href="../miguel-luque/index.html">Miguel Ángel Luque Fernández</a>.</p></div></section><div class="profile-related-surface"><svg class="profile-wave profile-wave-top" viewBox="0 0 1440 80" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M0 16 C280 16 420 32 700 48 C980 64 1170 64 1440 64 L1440 80 H0 Z"/></svg><section class="section wrap section-tight profile-related"><div class="section-heading"><div><h2>Related research areas</h2></div></div><article class="research-area-detail" id="research-conformal-inference" role="region" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="research-conformal-inference-title"><div class="research-visual"><img src="../../assets/line-conformal.svg?v=13" alt="" width="300" height="150" loading="lazy"></div><div class="research-area-copy"><h3 id="research-conformal-inference-title">Conformal inference for causal questions</h3><div class="research-area-body"><p>Conformal methods for quantifying uncertainty in causal estimands, including settings that use machine learning or have small samples.
